info.title: ControlR | Internal API
info.description: Dynamically-evolving internal API for first-party clients (BFF for UI, agents, etc.)

delete.description: Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/devices/{deviceId}` instead. The replacement resolves the device across tenants and enforces tenant access before the resource policy.

get.description: Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/devices/{deviceId}` instead. The replacement resolves the device across tenants and enforces tenant access before the resource policy.

post.description: Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/devices/delete-many` instead. The replacement evaluates tenant access per candidate device instead of pre-filtering by the caller's tenant claim, so server-scoped principals are supported.
Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/devices/search` instead. The replacement evaluates device access via the caller's access scope without requiring a tenant claim, so server-scoped principals are supported.

patch.description: Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/devices/{deviceId}/alias` instead. The replacement resolves the device across tenants and enforces tenant access before the resource policy.

post.description: Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/device-tags?tenantId=` instead. The replacement requires tenantId as a query parameter.

delete.description: Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/device-tags/{deviceId}/{tagId}?tenantId=` instead. The replacement requires tenantId as a query parameter.

post.description: Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/installer-keys` instead. The replacement requires TenantId in the request body.

get.description: Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/installer-keys?tenantId=` instead. The replacement requires tenantId as a query parameter and returns an Items envelope.

delete.description: Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/installer-keys/{keyId}?tenantId=` instead. The replacement requires tenantId as a query parameter.

get.description: Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/installer-keys/{keyId}/usages?tenantId=` instead. The replacement requires tenantId as a query parameter and returns an Items envelope.

put.description: Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/installer-keys/{keyId}?tenantId=` instead. The replacement takes the key id in the route, tenantId as a query parameter, a body with only friendlyName, and returns 204.

post.description: Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/invites?tenantId={tenantId}` instead. Use POST /api/v1/invites with an explicit tenantId.

get.description: Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/invites?tenantId={tenantId}` instead. Use GET /api/v1/invites with an explicit tenantId.

delete.description: Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/invites/{inviteId}?tenantId={tenantId}` instead. Use DELETE /api/v1/invites/{inviteId} with an explicit tenantId.

post.description: Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/logon-tokens/user` instead. The replacement requires TenantId in the request body; see also /api/v1/logon-tokens/external for server-scoped callers.
Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/personal-access-tokens?tenantId=` instead. The replacement requires tenantId as a query parameter, returns 201, and answers delete with 204.

get.description: Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/personal-access-tokens?tenantId=` instead. The replacement requires tenantId as a query parameter and returns an Items envelope.

delete.description: Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/personal-access-tokens/{id}?tenantId=` instead. The replacement requires tenantId as a query parameter and answers with 204.

put.description: Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/personal-access-tokens/{id}?tenantId=` instead. The replacement requires tenantId as a query parameter.

post.description: Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/tags?tenantId=` instead. The replacement requires tenantId as a query parameter, returns 201, and takes the tenant from the required parameter instead of the caller claim.

get.description: Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/tags?tenantId=` instead. The replacement requires tenantId as a query parameter and returns an Items envelope.

put.description: Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/tags/{tagId}?tenantId=` instead. The replacement takes the tag id in the route, tenantId as a query parameter, and a body with only name.

delete.description: Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/tags/{tagId}?tenantId=` instead. The replacement requires tenantId as a query parameter.
Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/tenant-settings/{name}?tenantId={tenantId}` instead. Use DELETE /api/v1/tenant-settings/{name} with an explicit tenantId.

get.description: Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/tenant-settings/{name}?tenantId={tenantId}` instead. Use GET /api/v1/tenant-settings/{name} with an explicit tenantId.
Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/tenant-settings?tenantId={tenantId}` instead. Use GET /api/v1/tenant-settings with an explicit tenantId.

post.description: Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/tenant-settings?tenantId={tenantId}` instead. Use POST /api/v1/tenant-settings with an explicit tenantId.

put.description: Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/tenant-settings?tenantId={tenantId}` instead. Use PUT /api/v1/tenant-settings with an explicit tenantId.

post.description: Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/users/{userId}/reset-password?tenantId=` instead. The replacement requires tenantId as a query parameter instead of deriving it from the caller claim.
Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/users?tenantId=` instead. The replacement requires tenantId as a query parameter instead of deriving it from the caller claim.

get.description: Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/users?tenantId=` instead. The replacement requires tenantId as a query parameter and returns an Items envelope.

post.description: Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/users/{userId}/personal-access-tokens?tenantId=` instead. The replacement requires tenantId as a query parameter and returns 201.

get.description: Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/users/{userId}/personal-access-tokens?tenantId=` instead. The replacement requires tenantId as a query parameter.

delete.description: Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/users/{userId}?tenantId=` instead. The replacement requires tenantId as a query parameter instead of deriving it from the caller claim.
Deprecated. Use `/api/v1/users/{userId}/personal-access-tokens/{tokenId}?tenantId=` instead. The replacement requires tenantId as a query parameter.
